content.title: Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time
content.intent: A linked Abhyasi sees eligible open slots from two linked preceptors in their timezone and books one instantly without approval.
content.technique_notes: EQP valid linked/visible/space-remaining input; state_flow valid transition to booking; timezone conversion uses UTC instant as oracle. Strength=3 (auth/data-loss risk); covering_array's eligible open combinations can be swept as parameters without assuming a concrete date or slot count. Additional dedicated timezone and multi-preceptor paths were budget-evicted.

capacity_classes: group capacity greater than 1 with space
